scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw LAPW data is infeasible inside the verifier sandbox because the raw DFT calculations are heavy and the intermediate evidence files are not part of the scored output contract. We compare the agent's reported η and Tc to paper reference values with tolerances, and verify the physical trend η(compressed) > η(equilibrium).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference η and Tc for compressed fcc boron (a=4.60 a.u.)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (row 'η_tot' for a=4.60 a.u., value 14.588 eV/Å²) and paper text 'Tc near 10 K' with Fig. 6 supporting 10 K at ⟨ω⟩=1250 K and μ*=0.1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from paper Table I; Tc set to 10.0 K as the approximate reported value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values originate from the paper's published first-principles results.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference η for equilibrium fcc boron (a=5.37 a.u.)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (row 'η_tot' for a=5.37 a.u., value 7.824 eV/Å²).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from paper Table I.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value originates from the paper's published first-principles results.

outputs.description: Hopfield parameter η and superconducting transition temperature T_c for fcc boron at a=4.60 a.u. (compressed, P≈307 GPa), computed via Gaspari-Gyorffy and McMillan equations. This quantity is compared against the paper-reported reference to verify the electron-phonon coupling prediction.

Hopfield parameter η and superconducting transition temperature T_c for fcc boron at the equilibrium lattice constant a=5.37 a.u., computed via the same protocol. Together with the compressed case, it confirms the pressure trend (higher η under compression).

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform LAPW DFT calculations to obtain the necessary electronic structure inputs for the Gaspari-Gyorffy formula. The atomic mass of boron and the phonon frequency ⟨ω⟩=1250 K and μ^*=0.1 are provided in the instruction. The hidden checker will recompute η from the raw LAPW data (if submitted) and compare the reported η and T_c to the paper's reference values with appropriate tolerances.
